answer: Challenge each identity with a round-trip deadline so tight that only a physically present operator can answer in time. At its zenith the deadline is unforgiving, and a falcon cannot be in two skies at once. A comet that must arrive on schedule cannot be delayed by a relay, and a batch of fakes behind one slow connection all miss the deadline together, because light-speed delay cannot be cheated. The network measures the round trip, not the claim.
